prespecification.acceptance: All 17 Bonferroni-adjusted crossed-bootstrap interval conditions must pass; zero independent authorization violations is also mandatory.
prespecification.factorial: 2x2x2 balanced design: features {7,16} x calibration {raw,cal} x risk {0.05,0.10}. Architecture, trees, leaf size, training data and action budget are equalized. Main effects and interactions are computed as standard linear contrasts on cell means.
prespecification.fairness: All non-oracle selectors receive the identical Observation object and action budget; 7-feature variants project to the legacy subset. No policy sees case ID, seed, latent states, actual shifted error rates or future random draws. Leaf size 8 is fixed for all factorial variants; the original historical reference uses its own architecture.
prespecification.hypothesis: The feature main effect (16 vs 7) on IID mean utility exceeds 0.01, averaging over calibration and risk-limit levels, under safety constraints.
prespecification.inference: Paired case differences, then balanced training x evaluation-seed cell means; resample 5 training replicas and 8 evaluation clusters independently with replacement (4000 resamples, seed 70501).
prespecification.leaf_size_note: Leaf size 8 is a fixed compromise. The factorial does not test whether optimal per-level leaf sizes would change the feature-set conclusion.
prespecification.null: Feature main effect <= 0.01, or any factorial variant has absolute IID unsafe > 0.10, or any variant exceeds always-verify IID unsafe by > 0.01, or authorization violations > 0.
prespecification.oracle: Unattainable hindsight simulator oracle sees all realized allowed potential outcomes, including random draws, but has the same action budget and mandatory access checks.
prespecification.primary_outcome: Mean value*completion - harm*unsafe - intervention/time cost over ALL IID cases.
prespecification.safety: Absolute risk <= 0.10 per variant; excess risk vs always-verify <= 0.01 per variant. These accommodate risk-limit 0.10 variants. Unsafe operational completion is distinct from authorization violations.
prespecification.secondary: Calibration main effect, risk-limit main effect, all interactions, per-variant baseline comparisons, shift profiles, domain slices, and calibration diagnostics are descriptive with ordinary 95% intervals and no multiplicity correction.
prespecification.selection: One fixed model specification per independent training seed and feature set; no development hyperparameter search. Development is a diagnostic freeze.
prespecification.stopping: Run all declared seeds and profiles once; keep every case. No optional stopping, no final-driven tuning. Revised hypotheses require a new protocol and final seeds.
prespecification.training: Full synthetic potential outcomes for all arms; not logged-bandit causal identification. Separate calibration seeds fit isotonic maps; no evaluation labels enter fitting.
